title: Monotonicity of randomized space
statement: Let $s_1,s_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s_1(n) \le s_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then every language in $\mathrm{RSPACE}(s_1)$ belongs to $\mathrm{RSPACE}(s_2)$, where membership means that a finite randomized machine uses space bounded by a constant multiple of the given function, accepts members with probability at least $2/3$, and never accepts nonmembers.
